svg.title: Three-stage fine-tuning pipeline for transformer models
svg.desc: A detailed flowchart showing Stage 1 general pretraining with masked language model on large corpora, Stage 2 domain-adaptive pretraining on ESG corpus, and Stage 3 task-specific fine-tuning with classification head. Each stage shows what data is used, what objective is optimized, which weights change, and what the output is.
svg.text: How a general LM becomes a domain classifier

g.text: Models: ClimateBERT · FinBERT · ESGBERT · EnvRoBERTa · SocRoBERTa · GovRoBERTa
Freeze lower N layers · tune top layers

svg.text: For LLMs (GPT / Llama): stages 2+3 use LoRA / QLoRA adapters — only adapter weights trained, base frozen
For BERT-family: full fine-tune with small LR (2e-5) is standard · 3–5 epochs · batch 16–32
